card.name: First digit of age and weight limits
card.fires_on: The first digit (or the space before it) of a number like 12 or 33 in age or weight cutoffs, such as 'under 12 years' or 'at least 33 kg'. It also fires weakly on small words like 'to' or 'at' in comparisons.

modes.label: Age or weight cutoff digit
modes.description: First digit of a two-digit age or weight threshold in pediatric use statements.
modes.example: are not intended for use in patients under <<1>>2 years of age.

modes.description: First digit of a percentage or strength in a dilution example.
